# anymd

> Any file to clean Markdown for AI agents: PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, EPUB, HTML and web pages, images (OCR), audio and video (metadata, subtitles, transcripts). A fast Rust MCP server and CLI that runs on your machine. No API key.

anymd is a Rust command-line tool and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server published by Sylphx (`https://sylphx.com`). It converts documents, slides, spreadsheets, e-books, web pages, images, and audio/video files into clean, structured Markdown locally on your machine with no API key required.

## Install and Setup

- npm: `npx -y @sylphx/anymd setup --client cursor,claude,codex`
- Cargo: `cargo install anymd`
- Homebrew: `brew install sylphxai/tap/anymd`
